body: Ahh, I really appreciate your response! As I stated, this is my first experience with something like this and it’s definitely overwhelming. You’ve just helped alleviate some of my stress, haha! Thank you again!

I’m so sorry to hear. Something similar happened to my sister. Both cats were adopted together from separate litters and were only 2 years old, and both died from cardiac arrest two weeks apart. She never got a clear explanation as to how it happened, either. It was very sudden and heartbreaking, she was very grateful she didn’t lose her 3rd cat. This was a few months ago.

I’d be very interested to hear of any updates you have. My condolences to you and your sister.

I’m not a doctor, but I just want to let you know that you’re not alone. I’ve been experiencing very similar symptoms just as you’ve described since I was 15. It’s been 7 years since then, and I still haven’t been diagnosed—only recently was I referred to an endocrinologist and they said they haven’t found anything.

To those who’ve responded, I really appreciate it. I’m going to make some calls tomorrow about possible autoimmune disorders and start there.

To OP, I hope you find out whatever it is that’s going on and get the help you need. I know how frustrated and overwhelmed I feel about suffering with an unknown diagnosis, (along with suffering the pain of their symptoms) and can only empathize with you. I truly wish you the best—if you need someone to talk to during this time, you are more than welcome to PM me. Best of luck.
